Eve - Sales: Urgent — NovaPOC hitting intermittent 5xxs during their scale test, exec walkthrough in 1h. Can ops triage?
Jon (ops): please share a failing request-id, time window, and model.
Eve - Sales: req=n-11aa22bb window 21:10-21:16 UTC model=rwd-large concurrent ~110rps.
ScaleBot: autoscaler: scale_up requested 21:09:58 -> target gpupool-6 (pending).
Priya (infra): checking logs. Ask customer to replay a failing id with X-Request-ID.
Eve - Sales: replayed, snippet: [2026-12-02T21:12:03Z] n-11aa22bb worker=gpupool-4 error=502 upstream="kv-cache OOM" throttled=true queue_len=1280 autoscale_pending=17s
Jon (ops): root cause appears to be KV cache pressure + backlog; autoscaler lag ~17s. Any routing rules preventing fallback?
Priya (infra): NovaPOC has strict routing (no-burst-fallback) per security questionnaire. I'll apply a one-time override for the demo window.
Priya (infra): override applied; route allowed to gpupool-burst and compatible variant rwd-medium.
Eve - Sales: client re-ran after 3m -> errors dropped to ~0.7% and demo continued. :tada:
Jon (ops): handoff notes: cause = aggressive kv-cache eviction + high concurrency + autoscaler cold start; mitigation = enable fallback for POCs, increase kv-cache for long-context models during demos, and reduce autoscale cold-start with warm pools.
Eve - Sales: customer asked about pricing to reserve burst capacity for next week — will follow up.
Priya (infra): I'll file a postmortem ticket and propose autoscale warm-pool defaults for POC orgs.
